visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A medium close-up features a female character with short black hair styled with light grey highlights. She is dressed in a grey textured zip-up sweater. She holds a sleek gold CELINE lipstick tube near her chin, her face exhibiting a slight, poised smile. The setting is a minimalist indoor studio with a clean off-white background and soft, even lighting. Yellow and white text captions are visible at the bottom of the frame. (2) The scene transitions to extreme close-ups of the product packaging. The character's hands, with dark burgundy nail polish, handle a white rectangular box and then a black velvet sleeve. She slowly removes the gold cylindrical lipstick tube, which has the brand's signature logo engraved on its cap. (3) The character swatches a soft nude-pink shade on her forearm, revealing a creamy texture with a subtle satin sheen. She brings the open tube close to her face to smell it, closing her eyes momentarily to savor the scent. Her facial expressions are engaged and informative as she speaks directly to the camera. (4) Close-up shots show the character applying the lipstick to her lips. She demonstrates two different shades, with on-screen text identifying them as #13 and #14. The camera focuses on the precise movement of the gold tube against her lips, highlighting the pigment coverage and the shape of the lipstick tip. (5) Returning to a medium close-up, the character summarizes her review. She uses expressive hand gestures, counting points off on her fingers and holding the gold lipstick tube to emphasize the value and high-end aesthetic of the item. The background remains constant and undisturbed.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 開箱超多人敲碗的. [Slogan]: CELINE唇膏!. (2) [Subtitle]: 由創意總監Hedi Slimane在. (3) [Subtitle]: 2023年創立的「Celine Beauté」系列. (4) [Subtitle]: 一開始是先出香水. (5) [Subtitle]: 後來就推出了美妝線. (6) [Subtitle]: 去年10月第一波. (7) [Subtitle]: 推出的就是唇膏跟唇刷. (8) [Subtitle]: 那時候我有去逛. (9) [Subtitle]: 但它只有出一色. (10) [Subtitle]: 就是凱旋門紅. (11) [Subtitle]: 我真的不喜歡. (12) [Subtitle]: 今年一月終於把唇膏全色號出齊了. (13) [Subtitle]: 我買了兩色我最喜歡的. (14) [Subtitle]: 回來試色給你們看. (15) [Subtitle]: 下方隨意留言!. [Slogan]: 還有多買一支要送給你們. (16) [Subtitle]: 唇膏的包裝非常精緻. (17) [Subtitle]: 它外面還有絨布包裝. (24) [Subtitle]: 聞起來是有那種. (25) [Subtitle]: 淡淡的玫瑰復古粉香感. (26) [Subtitle]: 另外我也買唇刷. (27) [Subtitle]: 也是金色金屬搭配壓紋環圈. (28) [Subtitle]: 可以蓋起來攜帶. (29) [Subtitle]: 唇膏全系列總共出15色. (30) [Subtitle]: 我試了一輪我最喜歡的是13跟14. (31) [Subtitle]: #13是裸粉色. (32) [Subtitle]: 這顏色我覺得最日常百搭. (33) [Subtitle]: #14是豆沙粉. (34) [Subtitle]: 上起來更有個性一點. (35) [Subtitle]: 膏體設計很好上唇. (36) [Subtitle]: 但不是一刷很滑順的質地. (37) [Subtitle]: 優點是包裝非常精緻. (38) [Subtitle]: 第二個保濕不太挑唇況. (39) [Subtitle]: 第三個它很遮唇色. (40) [Subtitle]: 即使是13最淺的顏色. (41) [Subtitle]: 也可以遮住我的唇周暗沉. (42) [Subtitle]: 缺點就是價格真的很不可愛. (43) [Subtitle]: 它的價格可以買兩支專櫃唇膏了. (44) [Subtitle]: 所以老實說我覺得. (45) [Subtitle]: 家中有類似妝效質地的話. (46) [Subtitle]: 可以不用買. (47) [Subtitle]: 但如果你是CELINE粉的話.
